description: The first non-PowerShell client for the Nerdio Manager for MSP API - cross-account AVD fleet audits, async-job plumbing, and offline search no other Nerdio tool has.

novel_features.name: Job poll-to-terminal
novel_features.description: Wait for any NMM async job to finish - polls until Completed/Failed/Cancelled and exits with a typed code reflecting the outcome.

novel_features.name: Fleet autoscale audit
novel_features.description: See every host pool across all customer accounts whose autoscale is disabled or diverges from your baseline - the Monday cost-control sweep as one command.

novel_features.name: Fleet host estate
novel_features.description: One table of every session host across all customer accounts with pool, account, and power state - the weekend power-sweep view.

novel_features.name: Fleet billing rollup
novel_features.description: Per-account billed/paid/unpaid/usage rollup for a billing period, joined to account names - PSA-reconciliation-ready without Excel.

novel_features.name: Scripted-action fan-run
novel_features.description: Execute one scripted action across many customer accounts, collect every returned job ID, and optionally wait for all of them to finish.

novel_features.name: Usage drift detector
novel_features.description: Flag customer accounts whose consumption grew or shrank beyond a threshold between two periods.
